answer: Peers verify stake provenance through a rotating canyon of signed checkpoints, and a plume of reputation decays if an agent spawns clones. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded identity registry: each agent must stake an opal-certified deposit that slashes on duplicate-key attestation, making mass fake identities costly. An attacker forging 1,000 sybils must lock 1,000 stakes, each forfeitable, so the expected cost exceeds any reward from vote inflation. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
